title: Admiralty Station Management Limited's deemed interest in First Real Estate Investment Trust rises to 46.02% from 45.92% in payment of management fees
body: Admiralty Station Management Limited's deemed interest in First Real Estate Investment Trust moved from 45.92% to 46.02% in payment of management fees. The transaction involved 3,944,778 units. No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 974,908,641 units (45.92%) to 978,853,419 units (46.02%).
deemed_interest_text: 3,944,778 units in First REIT (“Units”) had been issued to First REIT Management Limited ("FRML") on 5 November 2026 as payment for management fees (the "5 November Issuance"). As a result of the 5 November Issuance, FRML has a direct interest in 247,384,374 Units. OUE Limited ("OUE") is the holding company of FRML, OLH Healthcare Investments Pte. Ltd. (“OHI”) and Clifford Development Pte. Ltd. ("CDPL"). FRML has a direct interest in 247,384,374 Units. OHI, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of OUE Healthcare Limited, which in turn is an indirect subsidiary of OUE, has a direct interest in 677,997,828 Units. CDPL has a direct interest in 53,471,217 Units. Accordingly, OUE has a deemed interest in 978,853,419 Units directly held by FRML, OHI and CDPL (the "OUE Deemed Interest Units"). OUE is a subsidiary of Lippo ASM Asia Property Limited (“LAAPL”), which is jointly held by Admiralty Station Management Limited (“Admiralty”) and HKC Property Investment Holdings Limited (“HKC Property”). Accordingly, Admiralty has a deemed interest in the OUE Deemed Interest Units in which OUE has an interest.
relationship_text: Admiralty and HKC Property jointly hold LAAPL. OUE is the subsidiary of LAAPL.
remarks_text: The percentage of unitholding set out above (a) immediately before the 5 November Issuance is calculated on the basis of 2,123,220,314 Units; and (b) immediately after the 5 November Issuance is calculated on the basis of 2,127,165,092 Units.
change_reason: the issuance of Units as payment for management fees

body: Oh Kuang Eng's deemed interest in Mi Material Holding Limited rose after a party linked to the holder bought 250,000 shares in a market transaction. The direct holding is unchanged at 8,350,000 shares. Total interest rises from 370,090,500 shares (74.75%) to 370,340,500 shares (74.80%).
